parameters.filterByFormula: AND({STOCK LOCATION} = 'AB | EDMONTON OFFICE', DATETIME_DIFF(NOW(), {DATE | TIME VERIFIED}, 'days') = 0)

nodes.name: Airtable: Pull Verified Vehicles1
nodes.notes: Pulls all vehicles verified today at Edmonton office. Fields: VIN, make, model, year, color, status, body_type, new_used.

nodes.name: Build Telegram Messages2
nodes.notes: Generates Telegram messages: escalation alerts (sent first) + daily summary. HTML formatted.

nodes.name: GSheets: Clear Placement Map2
nodes.notes: Clears rows 2-36 of Placement Map before writing new assignments. Preserves header row.

nodes.name: GSheets: Write Placement Map2
nodes.notes: Writes all 35 placement rows (20 cage + 5 fence + 5 left + 5 loose) to the Placement Map sheet.

nodes.name: Webhook: Run Placement1
nodes.notes: Triggered by Vercel app 'Run Placement' button. POST body can include optional overrides.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook1
nodes.notes: Returns full placement response to Vercel app. Expects upstream nodes to provide: totalVehicles, cageFilled, fenceFilled, leftFilled, looseFilled, byCategory, placementMap array, escalations array, excluded array.

nodes.name: Read Schema1
nodes.notes: point to your rule_schema sheet tab

nodes.name: Read Rules1
nodes.notes: point to your rules sheet tab

nodes.name: Telegram: Send Placement PDF
nodes.notes:
Sends the PDF to your Telegram chat.

Setup:
1. Replace TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID env var or hardcode your chat ID
2. Update the credential reference to your existing Telegram Bot credential
